_comment: Desired production Firewall custom rules for dayrule.app. Compare with: scripts/firewall-check.sh. Edit live rules only via `vercel firewall`, then update this file and publish in the same change. Never use persistent actions (actionDuration) on rate limits — see docs/firewall.md and PLAN decision 36.

botIdPolicy.reason: PLAN decision 25 + 36: no BotID challenge script; Basic without checkBotId() is a no-op. Native clients cannot pass a browser challenge.

rules.name: Rate limit sign-up
rules.description: Sign-up sends emails: 10 per hour per IP+JA4 (CGNAT-safe; PLAN.md).

rules.name: Rate limit sign-in
rules.description: Prelogin and login: 30 per 10 minutes per IP+JA4 (CGNAT-safe; PLAN). Per-account lockout remains in the API.

rules.name: Rate limit recovery
rules.description: Recovery: 10 per hour per IP+JA4 (CGNAT-safe; PLAN.md).

rules.name: Rate limit email change
rules.description: Email change sends emails: 10 per hour per IP+JA4 (CGNAT-safe; PLAN.md).

forbidden.clientHeaderExemption: Never exempt by X-Dayrule-Client alone — spoofable.
